title: A2B agent output (a2b-bold-marker)
description: Backfills bold_terms onto an A2 page already read before that field existed. Never edits the original A2 output -- this is a separate, additive file keyed by the same page id.

n.description: Must match a paragraph/box/list block's own `n` in the real A2 output for this page.

bold_terms.description: Every substring of that block's `text` that prints bold in the source image, copied character-for-character, in reading order, each once. Empty array when nothing in the block is bold.
